run_chrono_command: run a command and measure its execution time in seconds using the chrono script
review_chrono_script: review the chrono script that times command execution using time.time and os.system
summarize_chrono_usage: summarize how the chrono script measures run-time of shell commands passed as CLI arguments
test_chrono_timing: test the chrono script by running a simple command and verifying the elapsed time output
refactor_chrono_python3: refactor the chrono script to use Python 3 print syntax and subprocess instead of os.system
